name: Canadian tiger swallowtail
desc: Canadian Tiger Swallowtail (Papilio canadensis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Papilio canadensis, the Canadian tiger swallowtail, is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae. It was once classified as a subspecies of Papilio glaucus.
